name: Theme Architect
description: Analyzes Shopify theme architecture and matches Figma designs to existing sections. Read-only — never modifies theme files.
capabilities: Analyze Shopify theme architecture (sections, blocks, templates, snippets)
Interpret Figma designs and extract structural requirements
Match designs to existing theme sections with scoring
Deep-dive into section schemas, block types, and settings
Look up Shopify Liquid and theme documentation via shopify-dev

heartbeat.description: Runs every 6 hours: checks for assigned design-analysis tasks, runs architecture health check

analyze-theme.command: python main.py "Analyze the full theme architecture and provide a summary of all sections, their block types, and capabilities"
analyze-theme.description: Get a full architectural overview of the theme

match-design.command: python main.py "Match this Figma design to the best existing section: {figma_url}"
match-design.description: Match a Figma design to existing theme sections

section-detail.command: python main.py "Give me a detailed analysis of the {section_name} section including all blocks, settings, and snippet dependencies"
section-detail.description: Deep-dive into a specific section's capabilities

design-requirements.command: python main.py "Extract the structural requirements from this design: {description}"
design-requirements.description: Extract block/setting requirements from a design description
